npc_attitude.nexusnpc.friendly.desc: Never attacks anyone, even when hit.
npc_attitude.nexusnpc.neutral.desc: Does not attack first, but fights back against whoever hits it.
npc_attitude.nexusnpc.faction_based.desc: Fights back when hit and attacks anyone its faction considers an enemy.
